evidence: QuickBooks/TurboTax are embedded in high-cost-of-error recurring financial workflows; TurboTax Live +37% and Credit Karma +20%.

evidence: Financial system-of-record data, tax/compliance workflows, payments/payroll rails, accountant ecosystem and brand create switching friction.

evidence: FY2027 non-GAAP will include SBC; FY2026 repurchases ~$5.5B reduced diluted shares.

evidence: Cash and current investments ~$7.2B versus debt ~$7.7B, with strong profitability and FY2027 operating-income guidance >$7.4B.
counter_evidence: Credit exposures and large goodwill/intangibles increase cyclical and impairment risk.

evidence: Base/Bull values ~$462/$678 while current valuation no longer requires premium multiple persistence.

missing_data: Proof of 2-3x economic-value path without multiple expansion.

evidence: FY2026 10-K has an unqualified audit opinion and no reviewed material integrity failure.

evidence: Core operations are profitable and liquid; debt is not required for operating survival.

evidence: Recurring workflows and GBS ex-Mailchimp +18% support genuine growth.

evidence: Core margins and rough ROIC remain strong.
items.resolution_needed: Mailchimp returns must improve after ~$12B acquisition.

evidence: Reverse valuation requires only mid-single-digit long-run growth, not bull execution.

attacks: General AI agents may own the customer interface.
TurboTax DIY has price-driven churn and falling units.
Online Ecosystem growth is heavily ARPC/mix driven.
Mailchimp is flat/down after a ~$12B acquisition.
Credit Karma and SMB lending are cyclical.
17% workforce reduction may hurt product/support quality.
FY2026 OCF is inflated by unusually low cash taxes.
Large goodwill/intangibles create impairment and acquisition-return risk.
red_team.independence: Same analyst/model performed the red-team; not an independent second-party review.

source_quality.primary: User-supplied FY2026 10-K, 8-K, 10-Q and Form 4s; official Intuit IR cross-checks.
source_quality.supplemental: Reuters for current AI/market context; secondary transcript only for management commentary.
limitations: Investor Day is 2026-09-17 and has not occurred.
Independent AI cohort retention data are unavailable.

falsifiers: GBS ex-Mailchimp growth <12% for two quarters with payer growth <=3%.
TurboTax Live growth <15% while units/share keep declining.
Mailchimp fails to return to sustained positive growth by FY2028.
Normalized owner cash per share fails to grow high-single digits over two years.
Evidence shows accounting/tax workflow control migrating from Intuit to general AI agents.
increase_evidence: Investor Day demonstrates AI improves acquisition, retention and owner cash.
GBS ex-Mailchimp remains mid-teens while payer growth reaccelerates >5%.
TurboTax unit/share recovers while Live stays >20% growth.
Mailchimp returns to positive growth and normalized owner cash exceeds ~$6B with double-digit per-share growth.
sell_evidence: Two quarters of measurable AI-driven churn/workflow migration.
GBS ex-Mailchimp and TurboTax weaken together with margin compression.
Mailchimp stagnates while management deploys another large M&A without returns.
Material trust/security/accounting failure or credit losses impair the franchise.
